a.lede: Microsoft says its systems are experiencing “elevated loads” as the company races to end an outage impacting its business and enterprise customers.
a.title: Major Microsoft Outlook Outage Leaves People With Email Jobs Unable to Email

b.lede: Over the last hour or so, reports have come in from around the world that people can't access their Outlook email, either through the web or apps.
